claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic hardware-independent VisualNeed -> ObserveIntent binding required by the canonical Perception Fabric. ObserveIntent binds exact source identity, ROI, requested heads, freshness, deadline, priority, compute ceiling, generation and immutable permission-snapshot digest without performing capture. Creation cannot mint truth/effect/completion authority. Execution-facing validation fails closed when the bound permission snapshot is stale, revoked, mismatched, expired or no longer grants the requested capability; REMOTE_FRAME and EXTERNAL_VLM remain separately rechecked at actual transfer/dispatch boundaries. Expired intents are non-replayable after delay/reconnect. Scope is repository source, deterministic falsification tests and repository-hosted CI only; no physical device access, VPS runtime claim, provider/VLM call, network/bridge I/O, UnifiedDB/world-truth mutation, effect authorization or whole-system/runtime credit.
